text:
Money you put into a retirement annuity can be deducted from your taxable income: up to 27.5% of your income, and up to R430,000 a year. Sipho's bonus (an illustration) pushed him into the 26% tax step, so every rand he puts into an RA this tax year saves him 26 cents in tax. Put in R5,000 and he gets about R1,300 back from SARS when he files. Remember: an RA is for retirement, and most of it stays locked in until you retire.

Full guide: "Your Bonus or 13th Cheque: How It's Taxed and What to Do With It (South Africa 2026)" on the Money From Zero channel.
